# Invited sessions

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
library(tinytable)
invtalks <- read.csv("files/invited_sessions.csv", header = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(number = 1:dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Session) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Session = paste0(
    number, ". ", Session, " (organizer: ", Organizer,")")) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
tab <- tt(invtalks) |>
  group_tt(i = Session) |>
  group_tt(j = list("Speakers in invited sessions"=1:3)) |>
   style_tt(
    i = seq(from = 1, by = 2, length.out = nrow(invtalks)),
    align = "l",
    color = "white",
    background = "#003C71",
    bold = TRUE) |>
  subset(select = -c(Session, Organizer, number)) |>
  style_tt("colnames", italic = TRUE) 
colnames(tab) <- rep("", 3)
tab
```
